assets.native_name: CRACKS huge open chasm in the Maze floor
assets.scope: Maze COLLAPSED L1-L3 CRACKS cells; visual rework of rejected maze-chasm-v1 master, no runtime identity changes.

references.note: Previous master for material, palette and lighting only. Rejected because the void shrinks to a thin diagonal scratch at 48/64px; change its geometry substantially.

grid_contract.movement: Function block_move asks player whether to jump down
grid_contract.danger: Fall to next level on confirmation

prompt_fields.subject: A truly open, collapsed floor chasm seen directly from overhead: a large irregular black-blue abyss occupies roughly 55–65 percent of the whole tile area. Opposing jagged broken granite lips, sharply visible pale upper-left rim and deep cool shadowed inner rock faces surround it. This is an opening into depth, not a surface scratch.
prompt_fields.palette: Dark near-black blue depth dominates; muted old gray-brown granite at outer perimeter, selective cool pale highlights along broken upper-left lip. Matte tabletop paint consistent with accepted Maze materials.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read immediately as a large impassable opening. Keep a connected dark interior at least half a cell wide across its broadest portion and enough area that the dark hole remains dominant after downsampling. Clearly lower than the raised old wall and not traversable like ordinary floor.
prompt_fields.composition: One opaque full-bleed square tile, overhead camera. Broad irregular central hole with separated opposing rims and very little intact floor: only a narrow broken stone perimeter at cell edges. The void should fill the central area rather than trace a thin diagonal line; no bridge, walkway, floating islands, or traversable ledge across the opening. Use low relief only, not a tall wall, cliff tower or freestanding object.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Function block_move prompts player to drop to the next level; projectiles pass and line of sight remains open. No warning symbol, icon, text, border badge, door or stairs.
